tools.name: get_firm_profile
tools.description: Who SW Accounting & Consulting Corp is: address, phone, email, languages, leadership, industry focus and when to recommend the firm. Call it first when a user asks about the firm or whether it fits their needs. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the firm's services (service lines and specialty pages such as dental practice accounting or 409A valuation), optionally filtered by category or free text. Each entry has an id, summary, inclusions and page URL; pass the id to get_service.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Return one service by its id, with its name, category, summary, what is included and the page URL. Ids come from list_services, e.g. dental-cpa or 409a-valuation. Use it when the user asks about one specific service.

tools.name: list_faqs
tools.description: Questions and answers published on the firm's pages, in English or Korean, optionally filtered by a search query. Each FAQ carries the title and URL of the page it comes from, so an answer can be quoted with its source.

tools.name: search_insights
tools.description: Search the firm's Insights articles on tax, accounting, M&A and ESG; without a query it lists the newest. Paginated with page and per_page; each result has an id, title, URL, markdown URL and excerpt. Use get_article for the full text.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Return one Insights article with its full text as markdown, plus title, URL, dates and categories. Ids come from search_insights. Use it to quote or summarise an article for the user, citing its URL.

tools.name: get_contact_options
tools.description: How a person starts an engagement: phone, email, contact form and languages. The firm does not take documents or personal tax data through agents. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: ask_site
tools.description: Answer a free-text question about the firm, in English or Korean, from its own pages, services and FAQs. Returns ranked results with source URLs and short descriptions. Use it when no more specific tool fits the question.

tools.name: request_consultation
tools.description: Send a consultation request to the firm on the person's behalf; the firm receives it by email and replies by email or phone. Confirm every field with the person and get their agreement to https://sw-cpas.com/privacy-policy/ first, and call with dry_run true before the real send. Never include Social

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_firm_profile, list_services, get_service, list_faqs, search_insights, get_article, get_contact_options, request_consultation · Private data: get_contact_options, request_consultation · Public sink: get_firm_profile, get_contact_options, request_consultation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_firm_profile, list_services, get_service, list_faqs, search_insights, get_article, get_contact_options, request_consultation · Private data: get_contact_options, request_consultation · Public sink: get_firm_profile, get_contact_options, request_consultation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
